name_zh: 仓库城，康托尔豪斯区和智利屋
name_en: Speicherstadt and Kontorhaus District with Chilehaus
intro_zh: 仓库城和毗连的康托尔豪斯区是德国港口城市汉堡市中心建筑密集的区域。仓库城最早是1885至1927年间建在易北河上一些狭长的岛上的（部分在1949至1967年间重建）。它是世界上最大的港口仓库群遗址（300，000平方米）。它包括十五个大型仓库区和六个附属仓库群以及一个相连的短运河系统。毗连智利屋写字楼，康托尔豪斯区是一片占地超过五公顷，建于二十世纪二十年代到四十年代的六座大型写字楼群，主要用于从事港口相关的商业事务。这片遗址展示了十九世纪末二十世纪初世界贸易快速发展的成果。
intro_en: Speicherstadt and the adjacent Kontorhaus district are two densely built urban areas in the centre of the port city of Hamburg. Speicherstadt, originally developed on a group of narrow islands in the Elbe River between 1885 and 1927, was partly rebuilt from 1949 to 1967. It is one of the largest coherent historic ensembles of port warehouses in the world (300,000 m 2 ). It includes 15 very large warehouse blocks as well as six ancillary buildings and a connecting network of short canals. Adjacent to the modernist Chilehaus office building, the Kontorhaus district is an area of over five hectares featuring six very large office complexes built from the 1920s to the 1940s to house port-related businesses. The complex exemplifies the effects of the rapid growth in international trade in the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
intro_local: Die Hamburger Speicherstadt und das Kontorhausviertel mit Chilehaus (englisch: Speicherstadt and Kontorhaus District with Chilehaus) sind ein UNESCO-Welterbe in Hamburg. Die Aufnahme in die Welterbeliste erfolgte am 5. Juli 2015 während der 39. Sitzung des Welterbekomitees in Bonn.
